When these conflict with the documentation results above or with what you remember, prefer the most recent dated source.\\n\\n{\"content\":{\"result\":[{\"rank_order\":1,\"title\":\"AWS IAM Identity Center extends multi-Region support to more AWS Regions - AWS\",\"context\":\"AWS IAM Identity Center, a service that connects workforce identities to AWS and streamlines access management, now supports multi-Region replication in additional AWS Regions, including those in AWS GovCloud (US) and AWS China. This feature enhances the resilience of user access to AWS accounts and applications by automatically replicating identities, entitlements, and other information from the primary Region to additional Regions. To learn more and get started, visit the IAM Identity Center product detail page and user guide\",\"url\":\"https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/02/aws-iam-identity-center-multi-region-aws-account-access-and-application-deployment/\"},{\"rank_order\":4,\"title\":\"AWS IAM Identity Center supports one-click multi-Region option for new organization instances - AWS\",\"context\":\"AWS IAM Identity Center has introduced a one-click option for enabling multi-Region support when creating a new organization instance.
